data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the XP-Master.
data_description.port: Port of the Netroni API, normally 8765.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the XP-Master.

abort.not_netroni: The discovered device is not an XP-Master.

init.title: Change an XP-Mini's fixture profile
init.description: Pick the XP-Mini to reconfigure. Use its Identify port buttons to find it if needed.

profile.title: Fixture profile for {mini}
profile.description: Current profile: {current}. The profile decides which lights this XP-Mini has and how its ports are driven.

confirm.title: Replace the lights of {mini}?
confirm.description:
Changing {mini} from {current} to {new} removes its {old_count} current lights and creates {new_count} new ones.

The current lights' names and areas are lost, and any automations, scenes or dashboards that use them must be updated.

Submit to apply the new profile.

abort.not_loaded: The XP-Master is not connected. Try again when it is online.
abort.mini_gone: That XP-Mini is no longer part of this XP-Master.
abort.profile_unchanged: That is already the XP-Mini's profile; nothing was changed.

set_profile.name: Set fixture profile
set_profile.description: Assigns a fixture profile to an XP-Mini. Its lights are replaced and their names and areas are lost.
